title: Reading the bill: pay as you go, reservations and Azure Hybrid Benefit

videos.script: The same machine, running in the same region, can cost three different prices per hour. {{three}} The difference is not the machine. It is the promise you make about it. {{promise}} Pay as you go promises nothing, and pays the most. {{payg}} A reservation promises one size, in one region, for a year or three. It costs less per hour, and every hour is charged, used or not. {{reservation}} A savings plan promises an amount of money per hour, wherever it is spent. An hour you do not use is gone. {{plan}} So when is a promise worth it? That is arithmetic, and you will run it yourself, with round numbers. {{breakeven}} Then a licence the company already owns. Azure Hybrid Benefit takes Windows off the bill, if you really have the licence. {{licence}} And last, a bill that looks wrong. Usually it is right about something nobody expected. You will learn which lines say so. {{end}}
